sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! No lower bar symbols are rotations of each other, and no PB symbol matches any SB symbol. This means each symbol in the lower bars is unique (not just a rotated version of another).
This suggests the goal is NOT to make all symbols the same or match symbols within the bar. Instead, the goal might be to match each lower bar symbol to a specific upper grid symbol.
Let me reconsider. I found earlier:
- SB2 matches S3@0°
- SB3 matches S1@180°
- SB5 matches S2@180°
- PB2 matches P6@90°
But SB1, SB4, PB1, PB3, PB4, PB5 have no matches with upper grid symbols. This is strange.
Wait, maybe I need to consider REFLECTIONS (horizontal/vertical flips) in addition to rotations. Let me check if the "non-matching" symbols match when reflected.
Actually, let me think about this differently. The upper grid has 6 S symbols and 6 P symbols. The lower bars have 5 S symbols and 5 P symbols. Maybe the goal is to select 5 out of 6 S symbols and 5 out of 6 P symbols, and rotate them to match specific orientations.
But the sky blue bar doesn't change with UP/DOWN. So maybe the sky blue bar is already set correctly, and only the pink bar needs adjustment.
Wait, let me reconsider the action model. I've only tested UP at one position. Let me test more systematically:
1. What does DOWN do? (probably reverse of UP)
2. What does LEFT/RIGHT do to the symbols? (probably just move cursor)
3. Can I change the sky blue bar at all?
Let me also check: maybe the sky blue bar DOES change, but I need to move the cursor to a different row. The cursors are at rows 48-49 and 59-60. Maybe pressing UP/DOWN moves the cursor vertically, and when the cursor is at rows 48-49, UP/DOWN affects the sky blue bar, and when at rows 59-60, it affects the pink bar.
But when I pressed UP, only the pink bar changed. The cursor was at position 5 (cols 43-47). Let me check if the cursor position changed.
Actually, I realize I should look at the current state more carefully. The image shows the cursors are still at the rightmost position. Let me check if the cursor row positions changed.
Let me try a different approach: let me test DOWN to see if it reverses the UP effect on the pink bar.
